_comment: Hierarchical scenario, 1 god/MJ + 2 faction players + 1 narrator. Use for storytelling sessions where a 'Dungeon Master' AI sets up situations, two players react in-character with their kingdoms, and a narrator broadcasts colorful summaries. Fog-of-war is on so each player only sees their own kingdom, the god sees everything and the narrator sees everything (with no action permission).

objectives.label: Create interesting tensions for the players
Broadcast notable events as they happen
